# Core Rule 9 - Robbing and Looting
When engaging in interactions that involve robbing, kidnapping, or searching another player, you must clearly speak in English. You are allowed to use other languages in casual settings, however this is an English server. It is unfair to players who have no idea what you are asking or demanding.
Being robbed is something you will likely encounter often, as [textlink="Bandits" link="RuleF1"] and [textlink="Renegades" link="RuleF2"] frequently patrol the Zone. These rules apply to all factions — individual factions may have additional robbing rules in their [textlink="faction pages" link="RuleC9Stalker"].
Remember - being caught in the act of robbery allows for immediate lethal escalation as specified within [textlink="Escalation" link="RuleC7Stalker"]!
## Who Can Rob
Factions that are hostile to each other are allowed to rob one another.
Loners are only allowed to rob people when accompanied by [textlink="Bandits" link="RuleF1"] or [textlink="Renegades" link="RuleF2"].
## General Rules - Nobody should be robbing Rookies of everything they have. If they have a green Rookie patch they're a new player with little to take. When engaging in antagonistic behavior with a Rookie take no more than one or two items from them. If they fight back they can be killed but shouldn't have all of their gear stripped. - When setting out to rob in lower tier areas like Cordon, expect to run into players who don't have much worth taking. Consider setting up checkpoints to charge a toll for passing, or seeking more creative ways of engaging with players in these areas. - When robbing a player, if they actively resist or make it difficult (constantly breaking restraints, trying to run, being overly uncooperative), you may put them into a critical state. However, you should use meds to revive them. If you have to revive more than once, you are allowed to kill and loot them — in this case, AHELPing problem behavior is encouraged. Resistance breaches the rules for Roleplay Standards, Fear Roleplay, and Suicide when captured. - Anyone clearly attempting to avoid a robbery when given clear indication a robbery is being attempted may be considered resisting. - Anyone being robbed should at least be left with enough gear to reach a safe zone without dying to mutants on the way back. - Robbers should NOT be using 'say' binds to rob people. You need to clearly type out that you are robbing said person. No Gmod "Drop 5k or die" binds. - No robbing or looting should take place in a [color=#008000]Green Zone[/color]. This includes SSD players and corpses unless permission has been explicitly given by the owner of the body. - Violent resistance (shooting the robbers, attempting to kill them) waives all protections and the robbers may kill and take whatever they please.
## Corpse Looting - You are allowed to loot dead people outside of [color=#008000]Green Zones[/color] if the body has rotted, but you are not allowed to watch someone die and then proceed to loot them. Given the opportunity, you should attempt to rescue them unless the situation is too dangerous to handle (e.g., heavily irradiated area, anomaly field with no protection, horde of dangerous mutants). - The robber factions ([textlink="Bandits" link="RuleF1"], [textlink="Renegades" link="RuleF2"]) may always steal from corpses they find outside of a [color=#008000]Green Zone[/color] - Corpses may always be looted inside of [color=#FF0000]Red[/color] or [color=#000000]Black[/color] Zones by anyone
## Robbery Limits - Anyone not at war with the robbing faction must be given a chance to comply with the robbery and pay a fine depending on their approximate carried value. This value should never exceed approximately 8,000 roubles and may be paid with in part or wholly with carried goods instead of cash. - If someone agrees to pay the fine they should be left alone for at least approximately one in game day. - Tolls can be set up within an area by the robber factions and announced over public PDA messages. - If a toll is announced anyone who does not tell a member of the robbing factions where they can be found to pay the toll within the area can be considered avoiding the toll and have a value of double the toll amount taken in either cash or gear from them should they comply when found. - Someone should not be considered resisting for walking down the main roads but may be considered resisting for the previous reasons if found out of normal sight of the main roads. - Robbing factions may ask for increased toll amounts for longer term protection within the given area up to 3x the toll amount for the remainder of the present server reset (or IC "week").
## Ransoming [textlink="Bandits" link="RuleF1"] and [textlink="Renegades" link="RuleF2"] may attempt to ransom someone they are not allied with and any other faction may do so for factions they are [color=##FFA500]hostile[/color] or at [color=#FF0000]war[/color] with following the rules below. - Ransomed victims should be returned with all of their carried items; some leniency is allowed for taking ammunition and medicine in emergencies. - Gear may be requested for a ransom. - Ransoms must be offered by the posting faction in good faith. Do not use them as an attempt to bait enemies for capture/killing. - The ransom amount offered should not exceed approximately half the value of carried items.
